# Tend2Thrive

> Tend2Thrive is a Professional Relationship Manager (PRM) — a CRM for people,
> not deals. It captures the moment you meet someone (who, where, and when) and
> turns it into a living memory you can come back to and tend. "Grow your network
> like a garden." Built by McDoCo, LLC. This site (tend2thrive.com) is the
> marketing site; the app is at app.tend2thrive.com and the programmatic API at
> api.tend2thrive.com.

## What it does

The one moment it's built around: you meet someone great, you both say "let's stay
in touch," and then the moment evaporates. Tend2Thrive answers the only question
that matters afterward — *who was that, and where did we meet?*

The loop:

- **Meet & scan.** Scan the person's code (or show yours — a digital lanyard with
  your photo, name, and headline). One action adds them to your people *and* logs
  the encounter to your timeline.
- **Remember.** Your timeline is a chronological record of every encounter — where,
  when, and private notes only you can see. A memory, not a headcount.
- **Tend.** Keep notes, save the details that matter, reach back out.
- **Earn the connection.** *Connected* means mutual and verified — you both showed
  up — not a one-way follow you can rack up by the thousand.

## How it's different

- **A memory, not a headcount** — the timeline remembers where and when you met.
- **Connections are earned, not collected** — mutual and verified, not a follow.
- **Your data, your rules** — per-field visibility across three tiers (Nobody /
  Contacts / Connections); export everything or delete it all, permanently.
- **Bring your own links, no lock-in** — LinkedIn, GitHub, X are just links on your
  card; verify the ones you can, leave with everything.
- **No password, no app store** — sign in with an email magic link or 6-digit code;
  install from the browser as a PWA.

## Who it's for

- People who meet a lot of people — at conferences, meetups, dinners — and are
  tired of watching good introductions evaporate.
- Communities and event hosts — organizations host events on Tend2Thrive and
  broker in-person introductions during them.

## For AI agents

To act on a member's behalf (read their contacts, timeline, or events; record who
they met), use the **API**, not this marketing site or the human app. The API's
own agent guide — how to authenticate with a personal access token, and which
operations answer questions like "who did I meet this week" or record "I met X" —
is published at https://app.tend2thrive.com/llms.txt.

## Product

- [Web app (sign in)](https://app.tend2thrive.com): the human web app. Sign-up is
  invite-only — join the waitlist at https://tend2thrive.com/#waitlist. Invites
  arrive by email; there's no code to redeem, you just sign in once you're in.
  People arriving on someone else's invite (a peer contact-invite, an event ticket,
  an org invite link) skip the waitlist entirely.
- [API agent guide](https://app.tend2thrive.com/llms.txt): auth + operation recipes for agents.
- [API reference (Swagger UI)](https://api.tend2thrive.com/) and [OpenAPI spec (JSON)](https://api.tend2thrive.com/openapi.json).
